body:
##  🌐 NxIP — Display Your Server IP In-Game

NxIP is a lightweight and clean utility plugin that lets players quickly view your server's IP using a simple command.  
Perfect for networks, SMPs, hubs, and servers that want players to remember the correct connection address!

---

## ✨ Features
- 🟢 Shows your server's IP using `/ip`
- 🛠 Fully customizable message via `config.yml`
- 🔊 Supports color codes (&)
- ⚡ Lightweight, no lag, no bloat
- 🎯 Works on Spigot & Paper 1.21+

---

## 📌 Commands
### `/ip`
Displays the server IP you set inside the config.

---

## 🔒 Permissions
- None! Everyone can run `/ip`

---

## ⚙️ Config Example
```yaml
# =============================
# NxIP- Config 
# Author: NotRenzo
# Support: https://dc.gg/nxdevelopment
# =============================

messages:
  ip: "&aPlay at: &eplay.yourserver.com"
  ```
